🎯 Unique Experiences

Tourist Activities in China

Unforgettable experiences – walking the wall, tea ceremony, tai chi, river cruise, panda visit

🎯 8 Featured Activities⏱️ 7 min read
Home◂Tourism in China◂Tourist Activities

Your trip to China is not complete without experiencing unique activities that are not available anywhere else. From walking on the Great Wall to watching pandas in Chengdu – these experiences will remain engraved in your memory. Arcadia Tourism includes these activities in its travel programs.

Walking the Great Wall 🧱

An exceptional experience of walking on one of humanity's greatest landmarks. We recommend the Mutianyu section (least crowded with the most beautiful views) – you can go up by cable car and walk at the summit with panoramic views of the mountains. Allow 4–5 hours for this experience.

Traditional Chinese Tea Ceremony 🍵

Tea has been a fundamental part of Chinese culture for thousands of years. In a tea ceremony you will learn the art of preparing and presenting authentic Chinese tea, and taste the finest varieties such as jasmine tea, black dragon tea, and Pu-er tea. A peaceful and enjoyable experience available in Beijing and Shanghai.

Tai Chi and Kung Fu Lessons 🥋

Learn the basics of Chinese martial arts with professional teachers. Morning tai chi lessons in the Temple of Heaven gardens in Beijing are a magical experience that combines sport, culture and spirituality.

River Cruise on the Li River 🛶

Sail for 4 hours on the Li River between Guilin and Yangshuo amid magical karst mountains – one of the world's most beautiful river cruises. The scenery resembles traditional Chinese paintings.

Giant Panda Reserve Visit 🐼

In Chengdu you will see the giant panda in its natural environment – an animal found only in China. The best time to visit is early morning when the pandas are most active. A perfect experience for families and children.

Shopping in Traditional Markets 🛍️

Shop in the most famous markets: Silk Market in Beijing, Nanjing Road in Shanghai, Muslim Quarter in Xi'an. Acquire Chinese silk, tea, porcelain and traditional crafts at excellent prices. Check cost guide to estimate your budget.

Acrobatics and Chinese Opera Shows 🎭

Chinese acrobatics shows in Shanghai are world-famous – with an amazing level of skill and creativity. Beijing Opera (traditional Chinese opera) is a unique cultural experience with its colorful costumes and distinctive music.

Chinese Cooking Experience 👨‍🍳

Join a Chinese cooking workshop with a local chef and learn to prepare the most famous dishes. A fun experience that combines culture and food. Available in most major cities. And if you're looking for halal options, we also have halal cooking workshop options.

💡 Arcadia Tip

All these activities can be included in our travel programs. Tell us the activities that interest you and we'll design a customized program. Also check travel tips to be better prepared.
